_schema._about: Every footer string and href (CONTRACT §3). Headline row with the filled booking button (hidden on home and on any page with a closing card), a hairline, the big lockup left, six link columns right, then a bottom bar: copyright left, a plain-text line right. No drawing, seal or mark anywhere in the footer. Hrefs match nav.json (canonical slugs).
_schema.headline: string. 40px display. Matches the closing card's default h2.
_schema.cta: {label, href}. The filled .btn--cta booking button (black label on jam), data-cta="footer".
_schema.columns: array[6] in order. {heading, href (heading link; null = plain label), items: [{label, href}]}. Services (9) · Solutions (6 by goal) · By brand (3) · Platform (4) · Company (3) · Legal (2).
_schema.copyright: string. One line in the bottom bar; {{year}} is replaced at build time. copyrightLines is kept for older templates only.
_schema.badge: {text}. Plain text in the old badge slot, bottom right. No seal, rosette or certification-like mark (DMCC Act 2024 Sch. 20 para 3). Once hypjam is incorporated, the company disclosure line (registered part of the UK, number, office; 2015 Regs reg. 25) goes here. Never a placeholder number.
_schema.sticky: {title, sub, label, href}. The phone bar (≤760px). SPEC §6.5.
_schema.anchor: string. The reassurance line under the closing card's button (partials/page-cta.html).
